sections.headline: 0 rules open, 2 status updates in STIG Manager, 1 held back (the scan's STIG is older)
sections.text: STIG Manager has no review that counts for these (none, Not Reviewed, or one rejected): the scan answered them. A fail is Open - and a finding to fix or put on the POA&M.
sections.title: 2. Not Reviewed in STIG Manager - the scan has an answer

rows: no review in V2R9 - V2R8: Not a Finding (accepted)
sections.text: DISA changed these rules since the scan's STIG, so STIG Manager has no review of them in its revision; the earlier revision's review counts and the scan (of that revision) agrees with it. Approved, the answer is written to the rule of STIG Manager's revision, with a comment that says it was carried forward - checked against the earlier revision's check, not this one. Update Evaluate-STIG to check them for real.
sections.title: 4. Carried forward from an earlier revision (check_stig_recheck_carry_forward)

rows: V2R8 (Evaluate-STIG) - 1 answer held back: the scan's STIG is older - 1 carried forward
sections.text: Only the rules STIG Manager has Open or Not Reviewed (check_stig_recheck) were checked; nothing is kept with the STIG drift report's scans. Checked: only these rules (Evaluate-STIG's -SelectVuln, or oscap's --rule) - fast - or in full when this Evaluate-STIG has no -SelectVuln. The STIG drift report checks every rule.
sections.title: Every host - what STIG Manager has Open / Not Reviewed, and the recheck

rows: the rule changed - the scan checked SV-1r1_rule, STIG Manager has SV-1r2_rule - the scan says pass, not written (update the scan's STIG to V2R9, or review it)
sections.text: The scan answered these, but DISA changed the rule since the scan's STIG (a new rule id): STIG Manager keeps the review of the old rule apart and has none in its revision, and the scan's answer is to the old check - so it is not written. They need a newer scan, not a person: update Evaluate-STIG to the revision STIG Manager uses and run the recheck again. Or set check_stig_recheck_carry_forward: true to write the earlier revision's answer where the scan agrees with it (said in each review's comment).
